durability: Identity rows are reserved 64 at a time in one FULL transaction. Each row is durable before attaching its xattr, and the inode remains synced before manifest publication. The schema and publication/retirement ordering are unchanged.
tests: Two concurrent connections allocate distinct identities across batch boundaries; offline GC discards unused reservations without recycling IDs and the same Live instance can allocate afterward. Injected partial-batch failure rolls back all rows without attaching an xattr. Process death before commit, after reservation, and after inode sync preserves native bytes and allows GC/reseal. Existing filesystem/Cargo/recovery suites pass.
